# Title scope: a Roman title that exists in Lux Renata's timeline but not ours, such as the Praetorian Prefecture of Macedonia
LR_canon_title_roman = {
	OR = {
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefecture_hispania # the Western hegemony's Hispanic prefecture
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefect_hispania
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefect_macedonia
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefecture_macedonia # the Macedonian prefecture of Lux Renata
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefecture_aegyptus # Egypt as its own prefecture
		this = title:e_praetorian_prefect_aegyptus
		this = title:k_diocese_mauretania # Africa split in two
		this = title:k_diocese_armenia # active in the 936 start
		this = title:k_diocese_syria # the Diocese of the East split in two
		this = title:k_diocese_palestine
		this = title:k_diocese_noricum # carved from western Illyricum
		this = title:k_praefectus_praetorio_macedonia
	}
}
